series_start_reason: First quarter the issuer prints a Vosevi line: the third-quarter 2017 release (8-K Ex 99.1, 2017-10-26). The 2017Q1 and Q2 comparatives in the 2018 releases are nil ('—'), so no earlier quarter is sourced.

notes: Scope: worldwide brand total, the unlabelled total beneath the U.S., Europe and Other International lines. Printed in millions. The regional lines sum to the printed total in all 13 quarters.
